title: MetaMask Core Perps advanced order types (TAT-3511)
description: Proves the TAT-3511 acceptance criteria against the headless Core checkout: every advanced order type (stop market, stop limit, take-profit market, take-profit limit, reduce-only, partial TP/SL) is placed through the controller's mapping path, is visible in open-orders state with its trigger data round-tripped (placement type, trigger price, execution mode, reduce-only flag, partial quantity), is cancelled, and the final state is asserted empty. Shipped with the package so any checkout can re-prove the contract. The per-type evidence is regenerated by the package's own e2e script and each acceptance criterion is then asserted as a node against that recorded evidence, so the recipe proves the same contract the epic gate depends on rather than re-deriving it. Error paths, the CI regression guard, provider-agnostic typing, the package build, the full test suite and the changelog are covered as further nodes. Evidence reuse: The per-type nodes assert against artifacts/e2e/*.json, which regenerate_evidence rewrites at the start of every run, so the recipe is self-contained and repeatable from a clean checkout while reusing the proof the package already produces. Runner gap: metamask.perps.place_order in this runner accepts only order_type market|limit and has no trigger_price / take_profit_size / stop_loss_size, so the six new placement types cannot yet be driven through native metamask.perps.* nodes. Once that action's schema is extended, the per-type nodes should become place_order -> assert_orders -> close_orders chains signing real HyperLiquid testnet orders. Follow-up on the runner, not this package. Testnet: The same matrix runs against real HyperLiquid testnet with `npx tsx e2e/advanced-orders.e2e.ts --mode=testnet --symbol=BTC` given PERPS_E2E_PRIVATE_KEY and PERPS_E2E_ADDRESS; no funded testnet credentials are configured in this environment.

evidence_exit_code.intent: AC4 — the evidence run exits non-zero if any type or any check fails

evidence_all_pass.intent: AC4 — every case in the evidence summary reports pass

stop_limit_placement_type.intent: AC1 — a stop limit order is visible with its placement type

stop_limit_execution_mode.intent: AC1 — a stop limit executes as a limit order once triggered

stop_limit_cancelled.intent: AC3 — cancelled and absent from final state

take_profit_market_placement_type.intent: AC1 — a take-profit market order is visible with its placement type

take_profit_market_cancelled.intent: AC3 — cancelled and absent from final state

take_profit_limit_placement_type.intent: AC1 — a take-profit limit order is visible with its placement type

take_profit_limit_cancelled.intent: AC3 — cancelled and absent from final state

reduce_only_flag.intent: AC2 — reduce-only survives placement as a first-class flag and is visible in open-orders state

reduce_only_position_view.intent: AC2 — the position trigger view carries the reduce-only flag for clients

reduce_only_cancelled.intent: AC3 — cancelled and absent from final state

unit_and_integration_tests.cmd: cd packages/perps-controller && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules yarn jest tests/src/utils/orderTypes.test.ts tests/src/utils/orderCalculations.advanced-orders.test.ts tests/src/utils/hyperLiquidValidation.advanced-orders.test.ts tests/src/utils/hyperLiquidAdapter.advanced-orders.test.ts tests/src/providers/HyperLiquidProvider.advanced-orders.test.ts tests/src/e2e/advanced-orders.contract.test.ts --no-coverage
unit_and_integration_tests.intent: AC2/AC3 — per-type validation, provider mapping, state update and place -> state -> cancel integration tests, plus the CI guard replaying the same matrix

params_are_provider_agnostic.cmd: cd packages/perps-controller && node -e "var fs=require('fs');var s=fs.readFileSync('src/types/index.ts','utf8');var m=s.slice(s.indexOf('export type OrderParams'), s.indexOf('export type OrderResult'));var vocab=['tpsl','triggerPx','isMarket','normalTpsl','positionTpsl'];var offending=m.split('\n').filter(function(l){return vocab.some(function(t){return l.indexOf(t)!==-1}) && l.trim().indexOf('grouping?:')!==0});var has=['triggerPrice','takeProfitSize','stopLossSize','reduceOnly'].filter(function(t){return m.indexOf(t)!==-1});console.log(JSON.stringify({vocabOutsideGrouping:offending,fields:has}))"
params_are_provider_agnostic.intent: AC5 — inspect the OrderParams declaration for protocol vocabulary and for the new provider-agnostic fields. Known pre-existing exception, unchanged by this ticket and therefore excluded: `grouping?: 'na' | 'normalTpsl' | 'positionTpsl'` (types/index.ts:247 on main) is HyperLiquid grouping vocabulary that already shipped in OrderParams; removing it is a breaking change outside this scope.

params_no_protocol_leak.intent: AC5 — the trigger and partial TP/SL extension introduces no HyperLiquid vocabulary into OrderParams; the only protocol-shaped field remains the pre-existing `grouping`

params_expose_trigger_fields.intent: AC5 — the placement extension is expressed in provider-agnostic fields a second provider can map

package_build.intent: AC6 — the package and every referenced project compile with the widened OrderType and the new exported types (`tsc --build tsconfig.lint.json`, the repo's typecheck gate). The emit-producing `yarn build` is deliberately not a node here: it runs with --no-references and therefore needs sibling packages' dist/ present, which other slots in this shared checkout remove via build:only-clean; it is verified out-of-band and recorded in report.md (root `yarn build` exit 0).

package_build_exit.intent: AC6 — typecheck of the package and its references succeeds

full_test_suite.intent: AC6 — the full package suite with coverage thresholds

full_test_suite_exit.intent: AC6 — full suite green, coverage thresholds met

changelog_validate.intent: AC6 — changelog entry present and valid

changelog_documents_types.intent: AC6 — the changelog describes the new placement types for consumers
